title: Pocket Planet Postcard Composer
oneLiner: A playful mini studio that lets users generate tiny animated planet postcards with mood, weather, soundtrack cues, and share-ready captions.
targetUser: Casual creators, students, and portfolio browsers who enjoy whimsical visual tools.
keyUX: Pick a mood, tweak a tiny world's atmosphere and motion, preview the postcard, and export a polished share card in minutes.
stitchPrompt: Design a whimsical desktop creative tool called Pocket Planet Postcard Composer for casual creators making tiny animated world postcards. It should let users pick a mood, customize a miniature planet scene, add motion and soundtrack cues, generate a short caption, and export a share-ready visual card. Include a live postcard stage, a mood preset rail, planet customization controls, animation and soundtrack toggles, a caption generator panel, and an export/share tray. Design direction: use a playful experimental aesthetic with bold gradients, soft-glow depth, toy-like controls, rounded cards, and a delightful gallery feel that prioritizes charm and shareability.
